caveats: Not representative yet: every yokai except the Kitsune and the Tanuki fights on the Kitsune's kit (node-scenes.json fallback_fighter), but with its own behaviour profiles and its own move files where data/moves has them (YOK-174: the Oni's five normals are in his kit but unused until his profiles name them, so Oni fights are throw-only for now; YOK-228: the Kappa's six normals and his throw are his own, his normals likewise unused until his profiles name them, so Kappa fights are his profiles' generic actions (walk, dash, block) and his own throw; neither has a special);each node's temperament is a seeded 50/50 roll from the run seed and node id unless node-scenes.json names a profile (see fight_mix); the apprentice's half damage (Y4, YOK-156) is applied; the bot never takes the dojo trial (YOK-98) and shops only when its config says so (the default newcomer heals at the merchant and rests at the dojo, R4's line), and fight time excludes menus (run length adds menu_seconds_per_node per node). YOK-179: elder nodes fight with their twist (data/twists/, applied as the fight scene does; elder_twists counts how often each fired; Elder Oni's armour cannot fire while the Oni has no special). levels.exchange_ratio counts unblocked hits landed / taken (designer 2026-10-21; null without the hit log) and levels.damage_ratio is damage dealt / taken; results before YOK-179 used exchange_ratio for the damage ratio and hit_exchange_ratio for hits. There is no round timer (designer 2026-10-21): fights go to KO, and max_fight_ticks is only a safety cap; a fight it stops is a stall, not a loss (outcome 'stalled', counted in fights_stalled, stalls_by_profile and per level in levels.<level>.duels_stalled), and its run ends there. Stalls count as neither wins nor losses: reach_tanuki_pct, beat_tanuki_pct_of_reached, run_win_pct and duel_win_pct leave them out of the denominator (the counts left out are reach_excluded_stalls, beat_excluded_stalls, runs_stalled, duels_stalled), and runs_ended_by_row counts lost runs only (stalled runs are in runs_stalled_by_row).
